extra rule (stateful, stage opening): Count the identity-confirmation asks. Answering a customer question comes first, and the ask after it is the second ask. If it is still unclear after the second ask, close not_reached/unclear. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (computational, stage identity): Convert a date of birth to YYYY-MM-DD. A date given only as numbers is read as day, then month, then year. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage identity): Three wrong answers in total across both questions end the check. A day_month_swapped retry and an unreadable value do not count. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage identity): Decline counter: explain once that the questions protect the account. A second refusal, or a second question about what the call is about, closes not_verified/declined. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (computational, stage negotiate): Interpret 'next <weekday>' as that weekday in the following calendar week and 'this <weekday>' as the one in the current week, relative to now. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Track the persuasion attempts used: a flat refusal or non-answer uses one, a proposed date or amount never does. Never repeat a refused offer. When the attempts are used up, close no_promise/refused. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): The floor offer after 'too much' is made once, and the below-floor counter-offer is made once. Refusing either one, or refusing the deadline offer, is a flat refusal. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Hardship (illness, a death in the family, job loss) takes precedence over persuasion and restructuring: give sympathy, make no attempt and offer a support transfer. A date or amount the customer names themselves is still recorded. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): A change during confirmation invalidates the earlier confirmation. Re-check the new value and read it back again before create_promise. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage global): Human-request counter: ask once whether you can help first, and transfer to general only if the customer insists. 'Do not want to talk' said twice closes the call. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage closing): If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as transferred with that transfer's reason, not as promise. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
